key_facts.fact: Adam Iza, a 26-year-old cryptocurrency businessman styling himself as the 'Godfather', was sentenced to 78 months in federal prison for a $37 million fraud scheme against Meta and tax evasion.

Adam Iza admitted to generating tens of millions of dollars through fraud, concealing millions in income from the IRS, and utilizing Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department deputies against his rivals.
The Department of Justice and the Internal Revenue Service detailed that Adam Iza was sentenced to over 6 years in prison for fraud, tax evasion, and corruptly using LASD deputies.
